villageHall.spec: Reduce the Grand Civic Assembly into its genuinely modest original District Office. Preserve the SAME CENTRAL PUBLIC DOOR, shallow front steps, core foundation/root, frontal camera, material scale and light. REMOVE the entire tall clock tower and observatory, grand flanking wings, upper storeys and most ornamental pinnacles. Leave one compact single-storey warm-stone civic chamber, a simple slate gable, practical timber side porch and one short navy banner with the proper Piltover crest. The smaller building remains at the same architectural source position; do not enlarge it to fill the canvas. It must visibly be the poorer weaker starting state, not the capitol painted a different color.

townHall.spec: Reduce the Grand Civic Assembly to its intermediate Civic Assembly. Retain the SAME CENTRAL DOOR, full shallow entrance steps, core lower chamber, source root/camera/material scale/light. Remove the high clock/observatory tower and grand upper wings. Keep the central chamber plus one asymmetric meeting-room side wing and a low second-storey clerk gallery under slate gables. Add modest brass lintels and two restrained navy/teal Piltover crest banners. Clearly richer and broader than a one-storey office but substantially lower and less ornate than the grand capitol. Keep source position, do not zoom it to fill the canvas.

cityHall.spec: Reduce the Grand Civic Assembly into the Trade Assembly, one step below it. Preserve the SAME PUBLIC DOOR/STEPS, full main foundation, source root/camera/material scale/light. Keep two substantial meeting wings and a two-storey central civic chamber, but remove the highest observatory crown and shorten the tall clock tower to one compact clock storey under a low slate roof. Less gold trimming and fewer pinnacles than the capitol; same worn ivory/brass/navy family and correct physical Piltover banners. Preserve source placement rather than zooming the shorter state to fill the frame.

fort.spec: Terrace Rampart: a broad civic city gate of warm hewn stone with one low deep arched passage, a practical bronze gate grille and two squat asymmetrical watch posts joined by weathered parapets. Warden/service fortification for a trade city: small navy Piltover banners, brass caps and timber railings; no cathedral, royal palace, giant crystals or dark Noxian keep. Full gate mass is broad and low, with a clear frontal road passage and shallow street approach. The upgrade can later add taller city-watch towers behind the SAME base gate and steps.

citadel.spec: Upgrade the SAME Terrace Rampart into Bridgewatch Citadel. Preserve main gate opening, foundation, entrance steps, source root, camera and light. Strengthen the lower walls with practical stone buttresses; add a second-level patrol gallery, raised side watch posts with bronze capped roofs and a visible reinforced bronze portcullis. Correct Piltover crest on physical dark teal banners. It must be distinctly stronger than the low rampart but leave room for one further taller bastion state. Do not add unrelated mini-palaces or change the gate location.

castle.spec: Upgrade the SAME Bridgewatch Citadel into Cliffside Bastion, retaining central gate, base walls, buttresses, stairs, root/camera/light. Add an elevated rear civic-watch keep, substantial asymmetric stone watch towers, brass-roofed instrument turrets and a high enclosed patrol bridge connecting the two strongest towers. Bronze structural fittings and navy crest banners, weathered urban stone; rich defended Piltovan trade-city architecture, no Demacian royal-wing symbols or generic white fantasy castle copy. Strong largest skyline silhouette, whole architecture uncropped.

mageGuild1.spec: Artificers' Archive I: a modest narrow two-storey ivory-stone academy archive with a clear frontal brass-inlaid door, practical timber reading balcony, dark slate pitched roof and one small bronze survey instrument on top. Shelved rolled plans and brass-latticed glass windows suggest scholarship; a short navy banner bears the proper Piltover crest. Craft and science, not a mystical temple. Base foundation and central door will persist through two taller archive upgrades.

mageGuild2.spec: Develop the SAME Artificers' Archive into Archive II. Preserve all lower architecture, door/steps, camera/light/root. Add one upper library/instrument storey, a brass-and-glass enclosed study balcony and a larger compact circular roof sighting instrument. More scholarship detail and richer stone trim, physical Piltover crest banner retained. Clearly taller/richer than the base, still below the greatest observatory version. No glowing magic dome or floating runes.

mageGuild3.spec: Develop the SAME Archive II into Archive III. Preserve foundation, public door/steps, lower rooms, camera/light/root. Add a slender high glass-and-bronze scientific observatory, compact dark slate cupola and precise nested mechanical sighting rings. Greater height and instrument complexity, not a church/wizard tower or giant magic crystal. Same muted ivory, bronze and dark teal family; correct Piltover banners. Full tallest state and contact shadow remain visible.

tavern.spec: The Brass Compass: a broad low foreground craftworkers' inn, warm older stone ground floor and asymmetric weathered timber upper wings, steep practical slate/gabled roofs, deep open public door with a small restrained amber interior, teal cloth awning and a hanging brass compass sign WITHOUT text. A visible painted Piltover crest on a navy porch pennant. Domestic working-city architecture, less refined than the civic skyline, varied roof masses, welcoming but worn. Wide grounded frontage, modest right side wall, no people or a whole ground rectangle.

marketplace.spec: Cliffmarket: one narrow, tall-fronted Piltovan guild shop, warm old stone base, worn dark timber upper gable, brass-latticed trade window and two small mismatched teal/brown cloth awnings. Baskets, bundled cloth and brass scales stay close to the wall. A physical navy Piltover crest pennant over the main door. Clearly a compact shop, not another academy/temple, no text or merchants. Frontal central door and tiny own stone step; slim vertical silhouette for a78x80native site.

blacksmith.spec: Civic Foundry: a broad foreground street forge of aged ivory/brown stone, sturdy weathered timber roof beams and asymmetrical dark slate work roofs. A deep frontal forge opening with restrained orange coals, hand bellows, iron tongs, anvil and a few practical bronze/steel castings. Short brick/stone chimney, brass roof vent, small dark teal Piltover crest cloth on a credible workshop bracket. One connected occupied workshop complex with wide grounded front and open service door; no giant factory stacks, modern equipment, people or floor plate.

resourceSilo.spec: Hextech Workshop: a narrow practical stone materials-refining workshop, a deep frontal brass door, compact timber loading hatch and a tall protected glass-and-bronze reservoir containing a SMALL cool-blue worked crystal. Opaque solid walls and painted glass reflections, no see-through building. Weathered brass pipes and roof vent imply scarce crafted arcane industry, not a green Zaun refinery or giant glowing monolith. Small navy Piltover crest pennant fixed to the wall. Slim silhouette for a60x76native site.

special1.spec: Extend the SAME Patrol Barracks into Warden Academy. Preserve the lower patrol lodge, entrance, steps, camera/light/root. Add a visible upper timber-and-stone training gallery, sheltered drill veranda and brass practice-equipment racks within the same site, correct navy Piltover banners. More substantial than the starting barracks without becoming a temple or moving the door. No students/soldiers or spare separate buildings. This is the intermediate state before the final Warden Drill Court upgrade.

special2.spec: Extend the SAME Freight Depot into Inventor's Guild. Preserve the compact machine-dispatch loading door, core foundation/root, camera and light. Add a small upper guild office with brass-latticed glass and a low side workshop canopy, survey tools and one restrained navy Piltover crest flag. Mechanical service community, not a palace. It is a visibly improved intermediate state in the same tight freight yard, below the full armored freight depot.

special3.spec: Cargo Exchange: a broad foreground Piltovan shipping and coach-service warehouse, warm older stone and patched timber, large frontal arched goods door, side loading porch, dark slate gables, practical brass pulley and restrained teal cloth coverings. Tied crates and rope bundles close to the wall, one credible large navy Piltover crest banner on the front. Mercantile community building rather than an isolated fantasy hall, full own shallow loading steps, no people/vehicles, no text or floor rectangle.

special4.spec: Progress Museum: a compact public museum portico, warm ivory/hewn stone, broad frontal double door, brass-latticed display windows, low dark slate roof with a modest geometric bronze crest pediment. Two small display cases containing simple tools/gears, a dark teal Piltover crest banner. It is a low small civic institution for a98x58native site, not a grand academy or duplicate town hall. Full shallow steps and restrained rightward contact shadow, no people/text.

dwellingLvl1.spec: Patrol Barracks: modest civic patrol lodge, warm weathered stone ground floor with a low timber upper loft, dark slate gable, a frontal public/service door and simple brass door lantern. A small shield/equipment rack and navy Piltover crest cloth identify Wardens without a royal castle silhouette. Compact grounded building for98x76native site; deliberately plain starting state with room for an Academy gallery and later richer Drill Court. No soldiers or copied champion weapons.

dwellingUpLvl1.spec: Upgrade the SAME Warden Academy site into Warden Drill Court. Preserve core lodge, central door, stairs, camera/light/root. Strengthen the stone ground floor, add a more complete upper drill gallery and deeper sheltered equipment veranda, better slate gables and dignified bronze civic trim. Correct Piltover crest on physical navy banners. Clearly richer, better defended and more organized than base/intermediate, still a civic patrol institution and not a generic fortress.

dwellingLvl2.spec: Rifle Range: a compact Piltovan civic rifle-depot/training gallery, sturdy warm stone base, worn timber range canopy, dark slate pitched roof and a clear frontal brass-trimmed service door. Small plain long rifles on a secured rack and distant wooden target silhouettes are attached to the same building, no firing people. A navy Piltover crest banner marks civic ownership. Sustained low-tier weapon supply, no oversized Caitlyn rifle or magical turret battery.

dwellingUpLvl2.spec: Upgrade the SAME Rifle Range into Sighted Rifle Range. Preserve base/loading door/foundation/root/camera/light. Enclose the upper training gallery with brass-latticed windows, add protected rifle-maintenance benches, a slightly taller angular slate roof and a compact brass rangefinding scope. Richer navy/bronze civic finish and correct Piltover crest, visibly stronger equipment without double-shot imagery or unique Caitlyn weapon copy. No people or extra detached target range.

dwellingLvl3.spec: Freight Depot: a small low Piltovan dispatch warehouse for compact wheeled freight machines, warm old stone and weathered timber, broad frontal loading door, low slate roof, a short bronze hand-hoist and one empty small wheeled brass freight chassis tucked beside the opening. Plain practical starting state, small navy Piltover crest flag. It must fit a compact88x59native envelope, not become a humanoid-robot temple or huge factory. No people, balloons or named Nugget's costume.

dwellingUpLvl3.spec: Upgrade the SAME Inventor's Guild/Freight Depot into Armoured Freight Depot. Preserve the freight loading door/foundation, guild office, source root/camera/light. Reinforce the low maintenance bay with sturdy bronze struts, add a protected machine-fitting canopy and a visibly stronger compact crane/hoist; one small wheeled chassis has practical armor plates. Correct navy Piltover flag. Clearly more capable than the base, no autonomous titan/huge new site or modern sci-fi factory.

dwellingLvl4.spec: Academy Bolt Atelier: a compact scholarly weapons-craft hall, ivory stone lower room, timber-and-brass upper workshop and slate gables. Frontal public door, wide brass-latticed work window showing a practical ENGINEERED CROSSBOW/bolt frame and drafting tools. Navy/teal Piltover crest cloth, small restrained blue instrument light. The building belongs to adult academy craft, not a cannon foundry, mystical temple or copies of a named young LoR prodigy. No people.

dwellingUpLvl4.spec: Upgrade the SAME Academy Bolt Atelier into Arbalist Atelier. Preserve the base workshop, door/steps, root/camera/light. Add a better enclosed brass-and-glass upper testing gallery, stronger roof braces, larger practical crafted-bolt workbenches and a precise compact mechanical sighting array. More substantial academic equipment and richer Piltover navy/bronze heraldry, distinct from the ordinary rifle range and mage archive. No giant energy cannon, splash effects or people.

dwellingLvl5.spec: Forge Crew Hall: a broad working engineers' cooperative, warm stone lower service room, older timber beams and asymmetric slate/gabled work roofs, large frontal door, hand tools, drafting-board shutters and a modest bronze precision instrument. Weathered materials, a restrained furnace glow from a side work hatch, teal cloth and a correct Piltover crest pennant. Practical living adult craft community rather than a priestly hall, robot depot, magical temple or mass turret factory. No people.

dwellingUpLvl5.spec: Upgrade the SAME Forge Crew Hall into Master Forge Hall. Retain its service door, low foundation, core work rooms, root/camera/light. Add a raised glass-and-bronze drafting loft, stronger protected forge canopy, superior precision instruments and richer practical slate roof framing. Correct Piltover crest cloth with better fittings; visibly more accomplished craft but still weathered working architecture, not a giant palace or cannon factory. No new troops/people/turrets.

dwellingLvl6.spec: Survey Launch Loft: a narrow tall Piltovan aeronaut workshop perched on its OWN stone foundation, an open timber/brass launch balcony, dark slate work roof, modest survey mast and a compact personal-flight craft/long powered board secured against the wall. Frontal service door is clear. Weathered ivory stone, brass, navy/teal Piltover crest cloth, small restrained blue device detail. Fragile scarce personal flight, not Corki helicopter, giant zeppelin, Zaun Firelight hideout or floating building. No pilot/people.

dwellingUpLvl6.spec: Upgrade the SAME Survey Launch Loft into Pioneer Launch Loft. Keep foundation, door, launch-balcony position, root/camera/light. Add a taller instrument mast with a small enclosed glass survey cabin, strengthened brass landing rails and a better sheltered personal-flight fitting bay. More substantial civic/navy/bronze trim and correct Piltover crest banners, clear upgrade with readable tall silhouette. No aircraft fleet, rotor helicopter or free-floating architecture.

dwellingLvl7.spec: Dockyard Workframe Gantry: a broad low Piltovan heavy-work-suit fitting hall, weathered warm stone and sturdy timber, large frontal service arch, dark slate industrial roof, exposed bronze/steel load-bearing gantry and a plainly visible EMPTY living-operator construction frame/harness suspended for maintenance. Realistic heavy cargo craft, not an autonomous Hexcore Titan, golem factory or generic sci-fi hangar. Navy Piltover crest cloth on the front and crane beam. Full own foundation/steps, no operators/people or oversized champion hammer.

dwellingUpLvl7.spec: Upgrade the SAME Dockyard Workframe Gantry into Reinforced Workframe Gantry. Preserve the central maintenance arch, lower hall, root/camera/light. Add stronger bronze/steel gantry braces, a more protected roofed service bay and a visibly better reinforced EMPTY operator workframe with heavy lifting arms/tools. Larger strong silhouette within the SAME low broad site, richer muted navy/bronze Piltover banners. Living-operated engineering remains explicit; no autonomous robot head, magical heart, giant cannon or people.

shipyard.spec: Harbor Slip: one compact Piltovan dry-land stone-and-timber quay/slip building, a small brass-trimmed shed with dark slate roof, frontal/landward door on the RIGHT, wooden dock stairs and a short practical hand-crane. Pier edge faces back-left water but all shed foundations remain on its own coherent quay. Navy Piltover pennant. Transparent cutout includes only the complete shed/quay/pier and subtle own shadow, no water or surrounding terrain rectangle, boat or people.

ship.spec: Complete the SAME Harbor Slip with its Moored Trading Sloop. Preserve the entire original quay, shed, landward RIGHT door, stairs, root/camera/light; add one small weathered timber trade sloop moored along the left water-facing edge with folded/reefed dull sails, brass fittings and a small navy Piltover flag. This replacement layer must include BOTH the original dock and the vessel, not a separate boat floating through the shed. Keep all boat/mast/rope full and uncropped inside the same compact109x74native site. No water panel, people or extra ship.

grail.spec: Progress Orrery: a small slender civic cliff beacon sculpture on a narrow warm-stone stepped plinth. A tall aged-bronze central pillar supports a precise open circular/ring instrument enclosing a small orb, with broad curved gear-flanked lower arcs echoing the ACTUAL PILTOVER CREST, physically built as a dignified monument. Muted gold/bronze, dark teal cloth detail and tiny restrained cool-blue instrument core; no gigantic glowing Sun Disc, wings, magic beam or temple. Very slim tall silhouette for a30x88native site, full own base/shadow, no people, backdrop or ground rectangle.
